summary: Length driven by GAAP line-item count, not multi-responsibility. Single input, single output, covered by fixture test.

findings.message: Twelve calls to sum(e.amount for e in entries if e.category == "X") — each iterates the full ledger. For small periods this is fine; if ledgers grow to 100k+ entries, a single pass with a defaultdict aggregation would be O(n) instead of O(12n).
findings.suggestion: If perf becomes a concern, replace with one loop that groups by category into a dict.
